描述_EN: its fine workmanship makes it a precious object in its own right. it was made during the tang dynasty (618-907), an era when china was in close contact with the middle east and the west and trade flourished along the famous silk road. during this period chinese craftsmen made a great many gold and silver objects, many of them inspired by arts and crafts of other cultures. this exquisite lidded box would have served as a container for medicine or a lady's cosmetics. this circular box, however, is not influenced by foreign design.
描述_ZN: 其精细的做工使其本身就是一件珍贵的物品。 它是在唐代（618-907）制作的，这个时代中国与中东和西方有密切的联系，贸易在著名的丝绸之路上繁荣。 在这一时期，中国的工匠们制作了大量的金银器，其中许多是受到其他文化的艺术和工艺的启发。 这个精致的有盖盒子可以作为药品或女士化妆品的容器。 这个圆盒，却没有受到外国设计的影响。
